summary.text: Rick James is a Republican state representative who has represented Kansas House District 4 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. His career experience includes owning an auctioneering service and working in real estate.

paragraphs.text: James' career experience includes owning an auctioneering service and working in real estate.
James took office in the Kansas House on January 13, 2025, succeeding Representative Trevor Jacobs.
During the 2025-2026 session he served on the Corrections and Juvenile Justice, Insurance, House Federal and State Affairs, and Elections committees.
